WatchedMovie.title: WatchedMovie
WatchedMovie.description: A movie or TV series marked as watched by an authenticated user, including TMDB metadata, runtime, cast, directors, language, emoji reaction, watch timestamp, optional season progress, and personal rating/note.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated user who owns this watched entry.

movieId.description: TMDB numeric movie or TV show ID.

title.description: Movie title or TV series name.

releaseDate.description: Movie release date or TV first air date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

userRating.description: User's personal 1-5 star rating (0 when unrated).

note.description: User's personal watch note or short review.

overview.description: Movie or TV series synopsis from TMDB.

genres.description: List of up to 10 genre names.

cast.description: List of up to 10 top cast actor names.

directors.description: List of up to 10 director or series creator names.

runtime.description: Movie runtime or average TV episode runtime in minutes.

numberOfSeasons.description: Total number of seasons for TV series (0 for movies).

numberOfEpisodes.description: Total number of episodes for TV series (0 for movies).

watchedSeason.description: Specific season watched by the user (0 = full show / unspecified, 1+ = specific season).

watchedEpisodesCount.description: Total regular episodes watched across seasons for a TV show.

watchedSeasonsCount.description: Total regular seasons marked as completed for a TV show.

watchedRuntimeMinutes.description: Sum of episode runtimes (or fallback average runtime) across watched episodes for a TV show.

nextUpSeason.description: Next unwatched aired season number when series status is WATCHING.

nextUpEpisode.description: Next unwatched episode number within nextUpSeason when series status is WATCHING.

currentSeason.description: Current active or highest tracked season number.

watchLog.description: Ordered list of ISO-8601 watch/rewatch date strings (YYYY-MM-DD).

watchedAt.description: Server timestamp when marked as watched (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

WatchlistItem.title: WatchlistItem
WatchlistItem.description: A movie or TV series saved to a user's Watch Later queue.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated user who owns this watchlist entry.

movieId.description: TMDB numeric movie or TV show ID.

title.description: Movie title or TV series name.

genres.description: List of up to 10 genre names.

numberOfSeasons.description: Total number of seasons for TV series.

numberOfEpisodes.description: Total number of episodes for TV series.

addedAt.description: Server timestamp when added to watchlist.

CustomList.title: CustomList
CustomList.description: A user-created custom collection of movies and TV shows with items metadata for collage previews and export.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated user who owns this custom list.

items.description: List of CustomListEntry objects (movieId, mediaType, title, posterPath, releaseDate, rating, originalLanguage).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when list was created.

UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: Per-user CineLog preferences including custom theme accent color and TV migration flag.

tvMigrationCompleted.description: Whether legacy TV shows have been migrated to season-wise tracking.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest update.

WatchedSeason.title: WatchedSeason
WatchedSeason.description: Season-wise and episode-wise watch progress for a TV series under users/{uid}/watched/{watchedId}/seasons/{seasonNumber}.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated user who owns this season entry.

seasonNumber.description: Season number (0 for specials, 1+ for regular seasons).

episodeCount.description: Total episode count for this season from TMDB.

watched.description: True when all episodes in this season are watched.

watchedEpisodes.description: List of watched episode numbers in this season.

watchedRuntimeMinutes.description: Total watched minutes accumulated in this season.

watchedAt.description: Timestamp when season was completed (nullable when incomplete).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest update.

/users/{userId}/watched/{watchedId}.description: Per-user subcollection of watched movies and TV shows keyed by movieId (for movies) or tv_{id} (for TV shows).

/users/{userId}/watched/{watchedId}/seas.description: Per-user subcollection of season and episode watch progress for a tracked TV series.

/users/{userId}/watchlist/{watchlistId}.description: Per-user subcollection of Watch Later movies and TV shows keyed by movieId or tv_{id}.

/users/{userId}/lists/{listId}.description: Per-user subcollection of custom curated movie/TV lists.
